lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The chair is at the bottom of the stack, facing away from you, and it turns around, which is the worst thing it could have done.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Oh, that's me. That is genuinely me. I didn't expect it to be so obviously me.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: Auditor. Eleven years, four commendations, one query.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: Sit down. There are four chairs and three of them are held by instruments — a trust, a fund and a holding company — and instruments do not sit, so there is room.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You have been paid every quarter for two hundred and eighty-one years.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: It is my property. I want to be careful here, because people always hear this as evasion and it is not. That is simply the legal position. It was taken in 2031, and it has never been contested — not lost, never contested.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: Nobody could find it in order to contest it, which is not the same as it having been hidden. Everything was filed. Everything was declared, correctly, every year, by people who believed declaring it was enough.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: You found it. I want to be clear that I think that is admirable, and I am not being gracious about it — I mean it professionally. Eleven auditors have sat in that chair. You are the one who pulled the thread.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: It does not change the position. The position is the only thing in this room that has ever mattered, and it is still the position.
